subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of the films are reviewers focusing on?

judge.implied_focus: The aspects/dimensions of filmmaking that reviewers concentrate their evaluation on (a taxonomy of review focus areas)

per_column.name: technical_craft_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures whether/which technical craft aspect (cinematography, editing, etc.) the review focuses on -- a coherent facet of review focus.

per_column.name: narrative_substance_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures story/plot/character focus -- a distinct, data-inferable facet of what reviewers attend to.

per_column.name: performance_evaluation_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures acting/casting/chemistry focus -- another clean facet of review focus.

per_column.name: emotional_response_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures viewer-experience dimensions (satisfaction, engagement, humor); coherent facet, though 'viewer_satisfaction' at 149 borders on generic sentiment rather than a specific aspect.

per_column.name: genre_convention_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures originality/cliche/genre-trope focus -- a meaningful and differentiated facet.

per_column.name: thematic_message_focus
per_column.rationale: Captures thematic/social/philosophical focus -- a distinct facet of review attention.

judge.rationale: All six columns converge tightly on a single coherent focus concept: a taxonomy of the film aspects reviewers emphasize, exactly matching the query. They form a well-differentiated, mutually distinct facet structure (technical, narrative, performance, emotional, genre, thematic) at a useful granularity, each with meaningful sub-values plus a 'not_present' option that lets an analyst quantify how often each aspect is invoked. This is directly actionable: an analyst can measure aspect prevalence and cross with label_pos to see which aspects drive sentiment. Minor weakness: the emotional_response_focus facet leans partly toward generic satisfaction/sentiment rather than a specific reviewable aspect, slightly diluting structure quality; otherwise the decomposition is strong and non-mechanical.
